# Ho-Smart v0.2.4 — Keep driveway alarm recovery working across restarts

**Focus:** Prevent temporary cloud outages, delayed Ho-Smart history uploads, or Home Assistant restarts from permanently skipping recorded driveway alarms.

## Why this update was developed

The previous update fixed the short lookback window and corrected the live motion pulse, but an in-memory history cursor could be lost when Home Assistant restarted. Ho-Smart can also publish alert history late, and incomplete paginated queries must not be mistaken for complete successful recovery.

## What changed

- Save the last successful cloud-history checkpoint and seen-notice keys to an atomic, per-integration file.
- Restore the checkpoint after Home Assistant restarts to continue recovery rather than treating previously delivered alarms as new.
- Recheck an overlapping **one-hour** history window to catch late-arriving notices.
- Reject repeated pagination cursors and page-limit truncation instead of silently accepting incomplete alarm history.
- Keep the v0.2.3 motion pulse, driveway-channel filter, and protection against stale recovered events triggering live automations.

## Limitations and testing

This update improves **cloud-history recovery and deduplication**; it cannot recover a physical alarm that Ho-Smart never records or exposes. A delayed historical event will not falsely activate live driveway motion. Vendor-cloud connectivity issues can still cause delays until the service responds again.

## Installation

Update through HACS and restart Home Assistant. Existing connection mode, credentials, and automation configuration remain unchanged.

**Full changelog:** [Compare v0.2.3...v0.2.4](https://github.com/gigabytegrove/hosmart-home-assistant/compare/v0.2.3...v0.2.4)
